deploy.startCommand: sh -c 'COPILOT=0; PROVIDERS=""; MODEL=""; if [ -n "$NVIDIA_NIM_API_KEY" ]; then COPILOT=1; NIM_URL="${NVIDIA_NIM_BASE_URL:-https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1}"; NIM_MDL="${NVIDIA_NIM_MODEL:-moonshotai/kimi-k2.5}"; MODEL="$NIM_MDL"; PROVIDERS="\"openai\":{\"apiKey\":\"${NVIDIA_NIM_API_KEY}\",\"baseURL\":\"${NIM_URL}\",\"oldApiStyle\":true}"; echo "[copilot] NIM: $NIM_MDL"; fi; if [ -n "$GOOGLE_GEMINI_API_KEY" ]; then COPILOT=1; GEM_MDL="${GOOGLE_GEMINI_MODEL:-gemini-2.5-flash}"; [ -z "$MODEL" ] && MODEL="$GEM_MDL"; [ -n "$PROVIDERS" ] && PROVIDERS="${PROVIDERS},"; PROVIDERS="${PROVIDERS}\"gemini\":{\"apiKey\":\"${GOOGLE_GEMINI_API_KEY}\"}"; echo "[copilot] Gemini: $GEM_MDL"; fi; if [ "$COPILOT" = "1" ]; then mkdir -p /root/.affine/config; printf "{\"copilot\":{\"enabled\":true,\"scenarios\":{\"override_enabled\":true,\"scenarios\":{\"chat\":\"%s\",\"coding\":\"%s\",\"quick_text_generation\":\"%s\",\"complex_text_generation\":\"%s\",\"quick_decision_making\":\"%s\",\"polish_and_summarize\":\"%s\"}},\"providers\":{%s}}}" "$MODEL" "$MODEL" "$MODEL" "$MODEL" "$MODEL" "$MODEL" "$PROVIDERS" > /root/.affine/config/config.json; echo "[copilot] Enabled, model: $MODEL"; else echo "[copilot] No API keys, disabled."; fi && node ./scripts/self-host-predeploy.js && node ./dist/main.js'

NVIDIA_NIM_API_KEY.description: NVIDIA NIM API key (optional) - enables AI Copilot. Get one at build.nvidia.com

GOOGLE_GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Google Gemini API key (optional) - enables AI Copilot. Get one at aistudio.google.com
